clue.text: Supports a parent but doesn't talk about it

definitions.meaning: to keep is to provide for, and mum is a mother
to stay silent and keep a secret, a British idiom

explanation.surface: Someone who provides for their mother quietly, without boasting.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase literally means providing for one's mother and idiomatically means staying silent.

clue.text: Nevertheless, netting first and last service

parts.note: even so means nevertheless

indicators.note: only the opening and closing letters of the word netting are taken

explanation.surface: A grudging comment about a church collection plate catching coins at the first and last services.
explanation.definitionFit: Evening prayer in the Anglican church is a service of worship.

clue.text: After a licking one's stuck in a corner

definitions.text: After a licking one's stuck in a corner

parts.words: After a licking one's stuck in a corner
parts.note: reads like a punished child sent to stand in the corner, but describes a gummed item licked and fixed to the top corner of an envelope

explanation.surface: A child, smacked, is made to stand in the corner.
explanation.definitionFit: The adhesive label proving postage is paid goes in an envelope's top right corner after being moistened.

clue.text: Climbs Everest and Ararat, say?

definitions.meaning: to mount is to climb or ascend
both are mountains, each called Mount, the question mark showing examples

explanation.surface: A mountaineer's question about scaling two famous peaks.
explanation.definitionFit: Ascends is a synonym of the verb, and the plural noun names peaks like these examples.

clue.text: They were wise, putting the scholar before the soldier

indicators.note: the scholar's letters are placed ahead of the soldier's

parts.note: an MA, Master of Arts, is a scholar
a GI is an American soldier

explanation.surface: A question of precedence between an academic and a soldier.
explanation.definitionFit: The Wise Men from the East in the Nativity story are known by this name.

clue.text: Preach no involvement — with her charges?

indicators.note: involvement suggests the letters of preach no are entangled and rearranged

explanation.surface: Advice to someone supervising young people not to get involved in preaching.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involvement' rearranges PREACHNO into the answer; the definition describes the woman accompanying her young charges.
explanation.definitionFit: An older woman escorting young unmarried people is always seen together with those in her care.

clue.text: Give us a song at the piano!

definitions.text: Give us a song at the piano!

parts.words: Give us a song at the piano!
parts.note: a request at a party for someone to perform music on the keyboard

explanation.surface: A party guest is asked to perform a tune on the piano.
explanation.definitionFit: Performing music on an instrument is what the request asks for.

clue.text: Is French class to part friends?

parts.note: est is French for is
a range is a class or category

explanation.surface: A question whether French lessons might separate friends.
explanation.definitionFit: To alienate people is to separate those who were close.

clue.text: Hero achieves eminence among top people

indicators.note: the eminence sits amid the letters of the top people

parts.note: aces are experts, the top people in a field
an eminence is a hill or rise in the ground

explanation.surface: A hero rises to fame among the elite.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek warrior of the Trojan War is the great hero of Homer's Iliad.

clue.text: River on course

definitions.meaning: small pegs used on a golf course to raise the ball

explanation.surface: Something found near water on a golf course.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tees is a river in north-east England, and golf tees are used on the course.

clue.text: He'll suffer in court if his driving is bad

definitions.text: He'll suffer in court if his driving is bad

parts.words: He'll suffer in court if his driving is bad
parts.note: suggests a motorist in a court of law, but means a sportsman whose forehand drive fails on a court

explanation.surface: A reckless motorist will be punished by a judge.
explanation.definitionFit: A competitor on a tennis court hits drives, and loses points when they go wrong.

clue.text: It could help chap shoot par, perhaps

definitions.text: It could help chap shoot par, perhaps

indicators.note: perhaps signals that the letters of chap shoot par may be rearranged

explanation.surface: A golfer hopes a good stroke will get them round in par.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' turns CHAPSHOOTPAR into the answer, and the whole clue describes it: a good shot onto the green helps a golfer make par.
explanation.definitionFit: A golfing stroke played towards the green sets up a putt for par.

clue.text: Pays out reluctantly when cold symptoms are on the increase

parts.note: coughs are symptoms of a cold
up means rising

explanation.surface: Someone reluctantly pays when they catch a worsening cold.
explanation.definitionFit: To hand over money grudgingly is an idiom for producing it unwillingly.

clue.text: Well, I wouldn't want this taken

definitions.text: Well, I wouldn't want this taken

parts.words: Well, I wouldn't want this taken
parts.note: a healthy person says they would not want a doctor's check; well means in good health, not an interjection

explanation.surface: A grumble from someone reluctant to accept something.
explanation.definitionFit: A doctor takes a patient's heartbeat rate, which a healthy person would not need.

clue.text: Persuade one to have cable at home

parts.note: a rope is a thick cable
in means at home

explanation.surface: Persuading someone to get cable television installed in their house.
explanation.definitionFit: To coax someone into taking part is an idiom from lassoing.

clue.text: Agrees about being dropped as one grows older

indicators.note: the letters for about are taken out of the word agrees

parts.note: re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: Someone becomes more agreeable with advancing age.
explanation.definitionFit: To mature or get older is to age.

clue.text: A small deposit secures!

parts.note: sounds like a shop advert about paying a down payment, but means a dab of glue holds things fast

explanation.surface: A shop sign promising that a small down payment reserves goods.
explanation.definitionFit: Glue or gum is a sticking agent that fixes things in place.

clue.text: The Spanish boy gets the girl

parts.note: el is Spanish for the
Len is a boy's name

explanation.surface: A Spanish lad wins the girl's heart.
explanation.definitionFit: Ellen is a girl's name.

clue.text: European schoolboy embraces school head

indicators.note: the schoolboy's letters wrap round the next piece

parts.note: an Etonian is a boy at Eton, the English public school

indicators.note: the head of the word school is its first letter

explanation.surface: A pupil hugs his headteacher.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of a Baltic state is a European.

clue.text: Love to exercise on the river

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, shaped like O
to exercise a right is to use it

explanation.surface: Someone who enjoys working out on the water.
explanation.definitionFit: The Ouse is a river in England.

clue.text: With brief notes jazz fans are sent up to the censor

indicators.note: in a down clue the word for the fans is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: cats is slang for jazz enthusiasts
Cato the Elder held the Roman office of censor

explanation.surface: Jazz fans are reported to the censor for clipped music.
explanation.definitionFit: Staccato is the musical term for notes played short and detached.

clue.text: Advocates breaking into stolen capital

indicators.note: the advocates go inside the word for stolen

parts.note: hot is slang for stolen goods
the bar is the collective name for barristers or advocates

explanation.surface: Lawyers burgle a city's stolen loot.
explanation.definitionFit: Hobart is the capital city of Tasmania.

clue.text: Particular pieces muddled by a learner

indicators.note: muddled signals the letters of pieces are jumbled

parts.note: L is for learner, as on British L-plates

explanation.surface: A learner gets specific parts mixed up.
explanation.definitionFit: Especial means special or particular.

clue.text: Concern for bird

definitions.meaning: a responsibility, as in the British idiom not my ...

explanation.surface: Worry about a bird's welfare.
explanation.definitionFit: Something one's responsible for is one's pigeon in British idiom, and it is also a familiar bird.

clue.text: Lose no time to suppress loquacity

definitions.meaning: to hurry up, idiomatically to accelerate a car
literally treading on idle talk, gas meaning chatter

explanation.surface: An instruction to hurry and stop chattering.
explanation.definitionFit: Pressing the accelerator means hurrying, and gas also means idle talk to stamp out.

clue.text: A boundary gives us the lead

explanation.surface: A border gives someone an advantage.
explanation.definitionFit: A margin or border is one sense, and an advantage over a competitor is another.

clue.text: Strikes may result when this is put out

indicators.note: put out suggests the letters of this are dislodged and rearranged

explanation.surface: Industrial action may follow when something is extinguished.
explanation.definitionFit: Blows or strikes are hits.

clue.text: At last he starts to warm up

indicators.note: the word at comes last after the word he, which starts

explanation.surface: Finally, someone begins warming up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'At last' puts AT at the end and 'he starts' puts HE at the front.
explanation.definitionFit: To heat something is to make it warm.

clue.text: Non-sleeping watch on worker

parts.note: a vigil is a night watch
an ant is a worker insect

explanation.surface: Someone keeps an all-night watch on an employee.
explanation.definitionFit: Being alert and watchful means staying awake.

clue.text: Ratification contains error

indicators.note: error suggests the letters of contains are set down wrongly and rearranged

explanation.surface: A ratified document turns out to contain a mistake.
explanation.definitionFit: Sanction means formal approval or ratification.
